scripts.build: npm run build -w @re-cinq/lore-shared && npm run build -w @re-cinq/lore-assembly-lines && npm run build -w @re-cinq/lore-server-core && npm run build -w @re-cinq/lore-api && npm run build -w @re-cinq/lore-mcp && npm run build -w @re-cinq/lore-floor && npm run build -w @re-cinq/lore-station
scripts.db:up: docker start lore-postgres 2>/dev/null || (mkdir -p .lore-pgdata && docker run --name lore-postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=lore -e POSTGRES_DB=lore -v "$PWD/.lore-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data" -p 5432:5432 -d pgvector/pgvector:pg16)
scripts.dgraph:up: docker start lore-dgraph 2>/dev/null || (mkdir -p .lore-dgraphdata && docker run --name lore-dgraph -v "$PWD/.lore-dgraphdata:/dgraph" -p 8081:8080 -p 9080:9080 -d dgraph/standalone:v24.0.0)
